name: @physics/web
description: React builder (place/move/rotate/link, snap, anchors), Three.js InstancedMesh renderer, play-mode UI over the 03 §5 worker protocol, analytics panel, IndexedDB local drafts.
_comment: P3a fills in the headless half: the editor model migrated from types/editor.ts,
the command algebra and history, id generation, the snapping system, the
reference cascades, the strict writer and the draft ring. All of it is
framework-free and DOM-free on purpose — it is the part that can be held to
04 by node:test rather than by looking at it, and P3c wraps it in Zustand +
React without changing a line of it.
Build posture is D30: emit to dist/, run node:test over the emitted JS,
because ci.yml's `unit` job includes Node 20, which cannot strip TypeScript.
It depends on @physics/engine/geometry rather than the engine barrel: the
barrel imports the Rapier WASM at module scope (03 §5.3's shared geometry
needs no physics build, and edit mode has no world loaded).
